Automatically Infer Pseudotime Trajectory from scRNA-seq Counts

Source: R/06_metrics_trajectory.R
infer_scrna_pseudotime.Rd

Estimates cell differentiation pseudotime directly from single-cell expression counts using diffusion/principal curve projection along the first principal component of top highly variable genes.

Usage

infer_scrna_pseudotime(data, n_top = 500)

Arguments

data

Expression or count matrix (genes x cells), or SingleCellExperiment object.

n_top

Number of top variable genes to use (default 500).

Value

Numeric vector of pseudotime values in [0, 1] for each cell.

Examples

data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
infer_scrna_pseudotime(example_scrna$ref)
